data.narrative:
Lucid Bots is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $36.4M to date. Valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), including same-stage peers Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised as a proxy base ($36M) and applies a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $69M. Peer-median analysis draws on the three same-sector, same-stage comparables listed above, yielding a median valuation of $1.8B with a range of $1.6B–$2.0B.

The analysis supports a wide range: $59M (low-end stage progression adjusted), $910M (simple median across methods), and $2.0B (peer maximum). The disparity reflects material uncertainty around Lucid Bots' competitive positioning relative to named peers. Stage-progression alone appears conservative given peer valuations; peer-median reflects current market for series-stage robotics but assumes Lucid Bots trades at sector median. Key uncertainties include revenue traction, proprietary technology defensibility, and burn rate relative to peers. Additional clarity on unit economics and market share trajectory would refine this range materially.
